dedupe_keys.name: aerialwaste dataset for landfill discovery in aerial and satellite images

description: AerialWaste dataset for landfill discovery in aerial and satellite images is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Rocio Nahime Torres et al. Illegal landfills are sites where garbage is dumped violating waste management laws. Aerial images enable the use of photo interpretation for territory scanning and landfill detection but this practice is hindered by the manual nature of this task which also requires expert knowledge. Deep Learning methods can help capture the analysts’ expertise and build automated landfill discovery tools. Coverage: not stated; published in 2023. Formats: JSON, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is Open Access, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
